scope: Five added answer guidelines for existing Health Connect staff review questions; original source chapter unchanged.

guidance.claims: Identify needed record types, operations and corresponding permission declarations; align Play declarations.
Check current grants before use, handle revocation, and provide permission management. Partial-feature presentation is design guidance.
Aggregate supported metrics; user-priority deduplication applies to Activity and Sleep, not every type. Custom metric definition is application guidance.

Use stable client IDs and versioning for exports, record IDs for imports/deletions. Committing local changes plus matching progress together and replay testing are explicitly application design guidance.
Explain data use in privacy policy; Health Connect provides record deletion APIs. Inventory of local/server copies, retention and deletion propagation are explicit product decisions.

link_verification: All six canonical pages opened in official Android documentation. The three cited get-started anchors were additionally checked against actual heading IDs in fetched HTML.
